messages:
maria_acme: Hey team — our embeddings panel (Workspace: AcmeAI) jumped ~300% at 09:12 UTC. Panel shows 'vectors' but numbers look like token-units; billing alerted us. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/def456

abby_support: Sorry for the disruption — can you DM org_id and a sample request_id so we can escalate? :ear:

maria_acme: Org: acme-ai. Request: req_2026_04_03_091200. Example curl we used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":["a","b","c"],"batching":true}'
```
Response included vectors:3, tokens:180. Dashboard panel EMBD-SUM-V3 shows 9 vectors and billing shows token-units ~540.

abby_support: Thanks — tagging infra and metrics. @sam_engineering @jordan_metrics can you take a look? Customer sees mismatch vectors vs billed units and a sudden jump.

sam_engineering: Looking now. Quick Qs: which time range on the panel and panel id? any recent client-side batching or retry config changes?

maria_acme: Panel id EMBD-SUM-V3, time range Today. We haven't changed SDK settings recently. We do have aggressive producer retries in our ingestion pipeline though (we retry network failures).

jordan_metrics: I see an ingestion spike for acme-ai at 09:12 UTC in our raw event logs. Two immediate hypotheses: (A) UI transform applied token->vector scaling incorrectly, or (B) duplicate ingestion due to at-least-once producer retries producing identical request_id but different event_uuid. I'll inspect raw events for that request_id.

sam_engineering: Can we get a raw event snippet from the customer? looking for event_uuid, batch_id, sequence_id. If producer retried, we should see identical payloads with different event_uuids/timestamps.

maria_acme: Raw event (redacted):
```
{"request_id":"req_2026_04_03_091200","org":"acme-ai","model":"text-embedding-3-small","inputs":3,"vectors":3,"tokens":180,"batch_id":"b-42","event_uuid":"evt_abc123","producer_retry":true}
```
I also see another entry with event_uuid:"evt_def456" and same request_id within seconds.

jordan_metrics: Bingo. Multiple raw events with same request_id but different event_uuid. Aggregation job was recently simplified (PR #8521) to group by request_id only; it no longer dedupes by event_uuid or batch_id. That allows repeated rows from retries to be folded into the same group but also causes the token join to multiply when tokens table rows aren't deduped — net effect: apparent multiplication of vectors/tokens in the dashboard.

sam_engineering: Repro steps for devs: run the local replay with two identical events (different event_uuid) into the aggregation pipeline:
```
python dev/tools/replay_raw.py --org acme-ai --file testdata/retries_two_events.json
```
Then inspect aggregation output for EMBD_SUM keys; you should see counts > expected.

sam_engineering: Quick mitigation: tell customer to temporarily disable producer retries or enable idempotent producer settings so retries are suppressed. Also we can add a quick server-side dedupe by event_uuid at aggregation stage as a hotfix.

abby_support: Shared workaround with customer: turn off retries on their ingestion producer for now. Customer confirmed they toggled retries=false and saw the panel drop.

deploybot: Hotfix deploy started: emb-dup-dedupe-hotfix by sam_engineering. CI green. ETA ~5m.

sam_engineering: Hotfix: reintroduce event_uuid dedupe and include batch_id in GROUP BY, and add a guard against joining tokens table multiple times for the same request_id. Pushed as PR #8530. Deploy id deploy-emb-fix-2026-04-03.

deploybot: Deploy succeeded: deploy-emb-fix-2026-04-03.

jordan_metrics: Kicked off backfill to correct the window 09:00-09:30 UTC for affected orgs. Backfill id: backfill-acme-2026-04-03-09 (internal link: https://internal/metrics/backfills/backfill-acme-2026-04-03-09). Estimated run 25-35m. Dashboards will refresh after backfill writes and cache TTL expiration.

maria_acme: I can see numbers normalizing already in Console. Thanks for the quick response.

sam_engineering: Follow-ups: 1) revert the prior simplification that removed event_uuid dedupe (done), 2) add unit-tests for producer-retry scenarios, 3) add an alert for sudden vector-to-token ratio spikes, 4) run billing-recon for impacted orgs and coordinate credits if necessary. I'll file a postmortem.

ajordan_metrics: Note for postmortem: UI panel had ambiguous units label ('units' vs 'vectors') which made this more confusing for the customer — we'll update panel legend to include explicit unit name and link to FAQ.

abby_support: Opening internal ticket SUP-2026-1192 and notifying finance for potential credits. We'll follow up once backfill and billing reconciliation finish.

maria_acme: Appreciate the fast turnaround and clear remediation steps. Keep me posted on the final billing reconciliation.

abby_support: Will do — leaving thread open until backfill and billing done. :white_check_mark:
